dialogues.jp: ピッ。
dialogues.en: *blink*
dialogues.text: *blink*

dialogues.jp: （そのうち、音夢が起こしに来るだろ……）
dialogues.en: "(Nemu will wake me up when it's time to wake up...)"
dialogues.text: "(Nemu will wake me up when it's time to wake up...)"

dialogues.jp: 「あ……そうか」
dialogues.en: "Oh... right."
dialogues.text: "Oh... right."

dialogues.jp: 音夢は、もう居ないんだっけ。
dialogues.en: Nemu... isn't here anymore.
dialogues.text: Nemu... isn't here anymore.

dialogues.jp:
「食生活に何の変化もないあたり、音夢の｛ごう／業｝
　の深さを感じるな……」
dialogues.en:
"My eating habits may not have changed, but there's still a
feeling of emptiness..."
dialogues.text:
"My eating habits may not have changed, but there's still a
feeling of emptiness..."

dialogues.jp:
今日も今日とて、菓子パンにコーヒーという食
事を済ませると、俺は席を立った。
dialogues.en:
As has become my daily habit, I quickly chowed down on a
sweet bun and a cup of coffee, then stood up from the desk.
dialogues.text:
As has become my daily habit, I quickly chowed down on a
sweet bun and a cup of coffee, then stood up from the desk.

dialogues.jp: 「何か……一人だと、広く感じるよな……」
dialogues.en: Somehow... this place seems to big for one person..."
dialogues.text: Somehow... this place seems to big for one person..."

dialogues.jp: 「今日から学園……か」
dialogues.en: "And so school begins again..."
dialogues.text: "And so school begins again..."

dialogues.jp:
歩き慣れた道を、見慣れた制服姿をぼんやりと
見遣りながら歩いていく。
dialogues.en:
As I walk down the familiar road to school, I absentmindedly
look at the familiar uniforms all around me.
dialogues.text:
As I walk down the familiar road to school, I absentmindedly
look at the familiar uniforms all around me.

dialogues.jp:
「何か、まばたきする内に過ぎ去っちまったよ
　うな気がするなあ……」
dialogues.en:
"Meh, I'm still so conscious about what happened last
month..."
dialogues.text:
"Meh, I'm still so conscious about what happened last
month..."

dialogues.jp:
それだけ充実していたって事だろうが、ただで
さえ短い春休みが、ほんとに短く感じられた。
dialogues.en:
Which in turn reminded me of the great spring break, and how
short it seemed.
dialogues.text:
Which in turn reminded me of the great spring break, and how
short it seemed.

dialogues.jp: 「夏休みが待ち遠しい」
dialogues.en: "Bring on summer vacation."
dialogues.text: "Bring on summer vacation."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「おはよっす〜」
dialogues.en: "Good morning~"
dialogues.text: "Good morning~"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、おはよ」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, morning."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, morning."

dialogues.jp:
視線が絡み合い、ただの挨拶のはずが、途端に
愛の言葉でもささやきあったような雰囲気にな
る。
dialogues.en:
We exchanged what seemed like a normal greeting, but a quick
glance of our eyes showed something deeper.
dialogues.text:
We exchanged what seemed like a normal greeting, but a quick
glance of our eyes showed something deeper.

dialogues.jp: 「新しい制服も、いいな」
dialogues.en: "A new uniform, huh? Looks good."
dialogues.text: "A new uniform, huh? Looks good."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Y, yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Y, yeah..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「に、似合ってる」
dialogues.en: "E, especially on you."
dialogues.text: "E, especially on you."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "T, thanks."
dialogues.text: "T, thanks."

dialogues.jp:
会話が止まってしまう。校門の真ん前で見つめ
合っているわけにもいかず、俺はひとつ咳払い
をした。
dialogues.en:
The conversation came to an abrupt end. Noticing that we
were blocking the entrance to school, I gave a small cough.
dialogues.text:
The conversation came to an abrupt end. Noticing that we
were blocking the entrance to school, I gave a small cough.

dialogues.jp:
穏やかな笑みを浮かべ、ことりがこくんとうな
ずく。
dialogues.en:
Noticing what I was referring to, she smiled embarassingly
and we started walking through.
dialogues.text:
Noticing what I was referring to, she smiled embarassingly
and we started walking through.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ね、ね、さっそく、クラス編成の掲示を見に
　行こうよ」
dialogues.en: "Let's go look at the class lists quick!"
dialogues.text: "Let's go look at the class lists quick!"

dialogues.jp: 手を引き、人だかりへと連れていこうとする。
dialogues.en:
She took my hand and tried to lead me through the wall of
people.
dialogues.text:
She took my hand and tried to lead me through the wall of
people.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、ことり、学内で、それはちょっとマズイ」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Kotori, it's school, we probably shouldn't..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, Kotori, it's school, we probably shouldn't..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あ、そうだね。ごめん、つい、いつもの癖で
　……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, yeah... sorry. I'm a bit used to it."
dialogues.text: "Ah, yeah... sorry. I'm a bit used to it."

dialogues.jp:
ことりはぱっと手を離した。名残惜しいが、そ
れも仕方がない。
dialogues.en:
Kotori reluctantly let go of my hand. I didn't like it
either, but we had to given the environment.
dialogues.text:
Kotori reluctantly let go of my hand. I didn't like it
either, but we had to given the environment.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「一緒のクラスだといいよね」
dialogues.en: "It'd be great if we were in the same class."
dialogues.text: "It'd be great if we were in the same class."

dialogues.jp: 手で口元を｛おお／覆｝い、耳元にそっと｛ささや／囁｝いてくる。
dialogues.en:
She made her hand into a mouth-shape and whispered to my ear
through that.
dialogues.text:
She made her hand into a mouth-shape and whispered to my ear
through that.

dialogues.jp: 「ああ……けど、何で小声なの？」
dialogues.en: "Yeah... what are you whispering for?"
dialogues.text: "Yeah... what are you whispering for?"

dialogues.jp: ことりに合わせ、後半は俺も小声にした。
dialogues.en:
Feeling I had to return the favour, I whispered to her as
well.
dialogues.text:
Feeling I had to return the favour, I whispered to her as
well.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だって、人前であんまり仲良さそうにするの、
　良くないじゃない」
dialogues.en:
"We shouldn't give everyone the impression that we're too
close..."
dialogues.text:
"We shouldn't give everyone the impression that we're too
close..."

dialogues.jp:
耳打ちしている時点で、ふたりがただならぬ関
係だって想像が付きそうな気がするが。
dialogues.en:
I would imagine whispering into people's ears would give
that impression more than casual talking.
dialogues.text:
I would imagine whispering into people's ears would give
that impression more than casual talking.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あっ、それもそうか」
dialogues.en: "Ah, well, that's true."
dialogues.text: "Ah, well, that's true."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あ、ううん、こっちの話。それよりほら、早
　くチェックしようよ」
dialogues.en: "Ah, uh, nothing. Anyway, let's hurry up and check!"
dialogues.text: "Ah, uh, nothing. Anyway, let's hurry up and check!"

dialogues.jp:
言うや否や、張り紙の前の人だかりの中に紛れ
込んでいってしまった。
dialogues.en:
As soon as she said that, she disappeared into the crowd of
people in front of the pieces of paper detailing the class
rosters.
dialogues.text:
As soon as she said that, she disappeared into the crowd of
people in front of the pieces of paper detailing the class
rosters.

dialogues.jp:
ことりが向かって右の方へ行ったので、俺は、
左の方から見ていく事にした。
dialogues.en:
Kotori had went off to the right, so I decided to start from
the left.
dialogues.text:
Kotori had went off to the right, so I decided to start from
the left.

dialogues.en: "(Year 1 Class 1...)"
dialogues.text: "(Year 1 Class 1...)"

dialogues.jp: （ねえな……）
dialogues.en: "(Not here...)"
dialogues.text: "(Not here...)"

dialogues.en: "(Year 1 Class 2...)
dialogues.text: "(Year 1 Class 2...)

dialogues.jp: （ねえな……）
dialogues.en: "(Not here either...)"
dialogues.text: "(Not here either...)"

dialogues.jp: （１年３組は……と）
dialogues.en: "(Now, Year 1 Class 3...)
dialogues.text: "(Now, Year 1 Class 3...)

dialogues.jp:
名前を探し始めた時だった。俺のすぐ隣で、掲
示を見上げていることりに気が付いた。
dialogues.en:
Just before I started searching, I inadvertently looked
around and saw Kotori standing nearby.
dialogues.text:
Just before I started searching, I inadvertently looked
around and saw Kotori standing nearby.

dialogues.jp:
「あれ、ことり。あっちから探してきて、ここ
　まで来たの？」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, Kotori. You've searched all the ones over there
already?"
dialogues.text:
"Oh, Kotori. You've searched all the ones over there
already?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あ、うん、そうだよ……もしかして、朝倉君
　も？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, yeah I have... you mean you have as well?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, yeah I have... you mean you have as well?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ああ。俺は、ことりの反対側から見てきたん
　だけど、ふたりとも名前はなかった」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh, I started from the opposite side. I haven't seen
either of our names though."
dialogues.text:
"Ahh, I started from the opposite side. I haven't seen
either of our names though."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……ってことは？」
dialogues.en: "...Is that so?"
dialogues.text: "...Is that so?"

dialogues.jp:
難しい顔をして、再び張り紙に向き合う。と、
しばらくして、その目が大きく見開かれた。
dialogues.en:
With a troubled-looking face, Kotori went back to searching
through the list in front of us. Shortly after, her eyes
opened wide.
dialogues.text:
With a troubled-looking face, Kotori went back to searching
through the list in front of us. Shortly after, her eyes
opened wide.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あれ……朝倉君、見て、ほら……」
dialogues.en: "A, ah... Asakura-kun, look there..."
dialogues.text: "A, ah... Asakura-kun, look there..."

dialogues.jp: ２カ所に指を指す。
dialogues.en: She pointed at two names side-by-side.
dialogues.text: She pointed at two names side-by-side.

dialogues.jp: 朝倉[name]。
dialogues.en: Asakura [name].
dialogues.text: Asakura [name].

dialogues.jp: 白河ことり。
dialogues.en: Shirakawa Kotori.
dialogues.text: Shirakawa Kotori.

dialogues.jp:
ふたつの名前に何度も視線を往復させてから、
俺は言った。
dialogues.en:
After looking at the names a few more times, I opened my
mouth.
dialogues.text:
After looking at the names a few more times, I opened my
mouth.

dialogues.jp: 「同じクラス……だな」
dialogues.en: "So we are... in the same class."
dialogues.text: "So we are... in the same class."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「やった！　やったよ！」
dialogues.en: "Yes! Alright!"
dialogues.text: "Yes! Alright!"

dialogues.jp:
俺の肩に手を乗せ、ぴょんぴょんと飛び跳ねる。
尻尾のように、長い髪が揺れた。
dialogues.en:
She held onto my shoudlers and jumped up and down for joy
like an animal. In place of a tail, her long hair shook like
one.
dialogues.text:
She held onto my shoudlers and jumped up and down for joy
like an animal. In place of a tail, her long hair shook like
one.

dialogues.jp: 「ことり……ことり。みんな、見てるって」
dialogues.en: "Kotori... Kotori, people are watching."
dialogues.text: "Kotori... Kotori, people are watching."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あはははは……」
dialogues.en: "Ah.. hahahaha..."
dialogues.text: "Ah.. hahahaha..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「う、うさぎ〜！　うさぎの真似！　ぴょん！
　ぴょん！　ぴょん！」
dialogues.en:
"R, rabbit~! I'm doing an impersonation of a rabbit! Hop!
Hop! Hop!"
dialogues.text:
"R, rabbit~! I'm doing an impersonation of a rabbit! Hop!
Hop! Hop!"

dialogues.jp:
ぴょんぴょん跳ね、途中でダッシュに切り替え
て、ことりは去っていった。
dialogues.en: She hopped madly past the crowd of people.
dialogues.text: She hopped madly past the crowd of people.

dialogues.jp: ｛あぜん／唖然｝とした空気をその場に残して。
dialogues.en: Dumbfoundness was abound in the remaining atmosphere.
dialogues.text: Dumbfoundness was abound in the remaining atmosphere.

dialogues.jp: 「……勇者？　おお、砂煙が舞ってる」
dialogues.en:
"...The school's brave heroine, indeed. Ohh, the dust is
clearing."
dialogues.text:
"...The school's brave heroine, indeed. Ohh, the dust is
clearing."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「お久しぶりです、朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "Long time no see, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Long time no see, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ともちゃん、みっくん。お久しぶり」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Tomo-chan, Mik-kun. Good to see you again."
dialogues.text: "Ah, Tomo-chan, Mik-kun. Good to see you again."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「……ことりったら、どうしたんですか？」
dialogues.en: "...Is something wrong with Kotori?"
dialogues.text: "...Is something wrong with Kotori?"

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「ま、春だからね」
dialogues.en: "Well, it's spring."
dialogues.text: "Well, it's spring."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「何げにひどい事言ってますね……」
dialogues.en: "That sounds worse than it should be..."
dialogues.text: "That sounds worse than it should be..."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「ふたりは、何組になったの？」
dialogues.en: "What class were you two given?"
dialogues.text: "What class were you two given?"

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp:
「残念。ことりとは、別のクラスになってしま
　いました」
dialogues.en: "Unfortunately, not the same one as Kotori's."
dialogues.text: "Unfortunately, not the same one as Kotori's."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「けど……大丈夫ですよね。朝倉君と一緒なら」
dialogues.en: "But... it'd be alright. You're with her, after all."
dialogues.text: "But... it'd be alright. You're with her, after all."

dialogues.jp:
そう言って、ともちゃんは、にこっと微笑むの
だった。
dialogues.en: Tomo-chan smiled gently.
dialogues.text: Tomo-chan smiled gently.

dialogues.jp: ◆一緒のクラス◆
dialogues.en: ◆Same Class◆
dialogues.text: ◆Same Class◆

dialogues.jp: 妙に短い春休みが終わり、新学期である。
dialogues.en:
The short spring break was over, and a new school year
began.
dialogues.text:
The short spring break was over, and a new school year
began.

dialogues.jp: ことりと一緒に、クラス編成をチェックした。
dialogues.en: I checked the class lists with Kotori.
dialogues.text: I checked the class lists with Kotori.

dialogues.jp: 何とも嬉しい事に、俺達は一緒のクラスだった。
dialogues.en: Happily, we ended up in the same class.
dialogues.text: Happily, we ended up in the same class.
